findings.detail: `CHANGELOG.md` announces that REQ-2026-082 fixed the landing/onboarding flow and `npx commitgate --help` (including `setup` and a dispatch/help cross-check), but this staged diff changes neither the landing/README nor CLI help/tests. From the review base, a normal user who follows the released changelog can open the unchanged help and still be missing the promised setup guidance; the release documentation therefore claims behavior that this commit does not deliver.

next_action: Either stage the promised README/onboarding and CLI help/test changes, or narrow the REQ-2026-082 changelog entries to only the Quick Start cost and review-budget disclosure actually included in this commit.
